title: FRAMEWORK ACT ON THE DEVELOPMENT OF THE ELECTRICAL INDUSTRY
full_text:
FRAMEWORK ACT ON THE DEVELOPMENT OF THE ELECTRICAL INDUSTRY

CHAPTER I GENERAL PROVISIONS

Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of this Act is to contribute to improving the national economy and public welfare by prescribing matters necessary for supporting and fostering the electrical industry to enhance its competitiveness and promote its sustainable development.

Article 2 (Definitions)
The terms used in this Act are defined as follows:
1. The term "electricity" means a form of energy generated by the movement of electrons, manifested in phenomena in which it is converted into, applied as, or used as light, force, or energy;
2. The term "electrical industry" means industries prescribed by Presidential Decree concerning the production, supply, use, management, etc. of electricity and other industries related to design, manufacturing, construction, supervision, safety management, diagnosis, etc.;
3. The term "electrical technology" means technology that uses electrical phenomena and is applied to the production, supply, use, management, etc. of electricity;
4. The term "electrical installations" means machinery, apparatus, electric lines, and other necessary installations used for the production, supply, use, management, etc. of electricity.

Article 3 (Basic Principles)
The basic principles of this Act are to recognize the significant influence of the electrical industry on the national economy and people's lives, promote the stable, economical, and environmentally friendly production and supply of electricity and its rational use and management, and develop the electrical industry in an environmentally friendly and sustainable manner.

Article 4 (Responsibilities of State)
The State shall endeavor to formulate policies for the sustainable development of the electrical industry and devise administrative and financial support measures, etc. necessary to implement such policies.

Article 5 (Establishment and Observance of Electricity Day)
(1) April 10 of each year shall be designated as Electricity Day to inform the public of the value of electricity as a driving force of national economic development and to inspire pride and self-esteem among those engaged in the electrical industry.
(2) The State and local governments may hold commemorative events consistent with the purpose of Electricity Day.
(3) Matters necessary for commemorative events for Electricity Day under paragraph (2) shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.

Article 6 (Relationship to Other Acts)
(1) When enacting or amending other Acts concerning electrical industry policies, the State shall ensure that they conform to the purpose and basic principles of this Act.
(2) Except as otherwise specifically provided in other Acts, this Act shall govern support for and fostering of the sustainable development of the electrical industry.

CHAPTER II FORMULATION OF ELECTRICAL INDUSTRY POLICIES

Article 7 (Formulation of Master Plan for Development of Electrical Industry, etc.)
(1) To promote the sustainable development of the electrical industry, the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment shall formulate a master plan for the development of the electrical industry (hereinafter referred to as the "master plan") every five years, following consultation with the heads of relevant central administrative agencies and deliberation by the Electric Power Policy Deliberation Council under Article 47-2 of the Electric Utility Act. <Amended on October 1, 2025>
(2) The master plan shall include the following matters:
1. Matters concerning the basic direction of policies for the sustainable development of the electrical industry;
2. Matters concerning the current state and prospects of the electrical industry in Korea and abroad;
3. Matters concerning support for research and development related to the electrical industry;
4. Matters concerning the training of specialized personnel and creation of jobs related to the electrical industry;
5. Matters concerning international cooperation and support for overseas expansion related to the electrical industry;
6. Matters concerning the creation of markets utilizing electrical technology and electrical installations;
7. Matters concerning the establishment of a foundation for an electrical safety culture;
8. Other matters concerning the sustainable development of the electrical industry that are prescribed by Presidential Decree.
(3) Where the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment intends to amend the master plan, the Minister shall consult with the heads of relevant central administrative agencies and undergo deliberation by the Electric Power Policy Deliberation Council under Article 47-2 of the Electric Utility Act: Provided, That this shall not apply to amendments to minor matters prescribed by Presidential Decree. <Amended on October 1, 2025>
(4) Where necessary to formulate or amend the master plan, the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment may request electricity business operators under subparagraph 2 of Article 2 of the Electric Utility Act, the Korea Power Exchange under Article 35 of that Act, and other relevant institutions and organizations prescribed by Presidential Decree to submit relevant materials. In such cases, a person receiving such a request shall comply unless there is a special reason not to do so. <Amended on October 1, 2025>
(5) The Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment and the heads of relevant central administrative agencies shall formulate and implement annual implementation plans (hereinafter referred to as "implementation plans") in accordance with the master plan. In such cases, the heads of relevant central administrative agencies shall submit their implementation plans and implementation results to the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment. <Amended on October 1, 2025>
(6) Other matters necessary for the formulation and implementation of the master plan and implementation plans shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.

Article 8 (Surveys of Current State of Electrical Industry)
(1) The Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment may conduct surveys of the current state of the electrical industry to efficiently formulate and implement the master plan and implementation plans. <Amended on October 1, 2025>
(2) Where necessary for surveys under paragraph (1), the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment may request the heads of relevant central administrative agencies, local governments, public institutions under Article 4 of the Act on the Management of Public Institutions (hereinafter referred to as "public institutions"), or relevant institutions and organizations, or business operators related to the electrical industry, etc. to submit relevant materials or state their opinions. In such cases, a person requested to submit materials or state opinions shall comply with the request unless there is a special reason not to do so. <Amended on October 1, 2025>
(3) Other matters necessary for the subjects, methods, etc. of such surveys shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.

CHAPTER III SUPPORT FOR AND DEVELOPMENT OF THE FOUNDATION FOR THE ELECTRICAL INDUSTRY

Article 9 (Research, Development, Demonstration, and Dissemination of Electrical Technology)
(1) To ensure the sustainable development of the electrical industry, the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment may have public institutions, universities, corporations, and organizations related to research and development of electrical technology, etc. (including their affiliated research institutes, etc.; hereinafter referred to as "electrical technology research institutions") carry out projects for the research, development, demonstration, and dissemination of electrical technology. <Amended on October 1, 2025>
(2) The Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment may make contributions or provide support to cover all or part of the costs necessary for carrying out projects under paragraph (1). <Amended on October 1, 2025>
(3) Matters necessary for the criteria for payment, use, and management of contributions or support funds under paragraph (2), etc. shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.

Article 10 (Training of Specialized Personnel for the Electrical Industry)
(1) The Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment shall formulate and implement measures necessary for the training of specialized personnel to develop the electrical industry. <Amended on October 1, 2025>
(2) The Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment may designate specialized personnel training institutions from among the following institutions and organizations and have them provide education, further training, research, training, etc. (hereinafter referred to as "education, etc."): <Amended on October 1, 2025>
1. Organizations of electrical construction business operators under Article 25 of the Electrical Construction Business Act;
2. Organizations of electric technology professionals under Article 18 of the Electric Technology Management Act;
3. Other institutions or organizations related to the electrical industry prescribed by Presidential Decree.
(3) The Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment may support all or part of the costs necessary for education, etc. provided by institutions or organizations designated as specialized personnel training institutions. <Amended on October 1, 2025>
(4) Matters necessary for the designation procedures and contents of education, etc. under paragraph (2), and the payment, use, and management of support funds under paragraph (3), etc. shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.

Article 11 (Promotion of International Cooperation and Entry into Overseas Markets)
(1) The Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment shall endeavor to identify international trends concerning the electrical industry and promote international cooperation. <Amended on October 1, 2025>
(2) To promote international cooperation and entry into overseas markets by the electrical industry, the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment may, as prescribed by Presidential Decree, provide necessary support to persons undertaking projects such as international exchanges of technology and personnel related to the electrical industry, international standardization, and international joint research and development. <Amended on October 1, 2025>

Article 12 (Promotion of Convergence with Other Industries)
The Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment may provide support for commercialization, pilot projects, etc. to promote convergence between the electrical industry and other industries and create new technologies and services. <Amended on October 1, 2025>

Article 13 (Promotion of Digital Transformation of the Electrical Industry)
(1) The Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment may provide necessary support to promote the digital transformation of the electrical industry and establish a foundation therefor. <Amended on October 1, 2025>
(2) The Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment may have electrical technology research institutions carry out projects related to promoting the digital transformation of the electrical industry. <Amended on October 1, 2025>
(3) The Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment may support all or part of the costs necessary for carrying out projects under paragraph (2). <Amended on October 1, 2025>
(4) Matters necessary for the contents and implementation methods of projects under paragraph (2), and the payment, use, and management of support funds under paragraph (3), etc. shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.

Article 14 (Financial Support, etc.)
The State and local governments may provide financial and administrative support for the sustainable development of the electrical industry.

Article 15 (Technical Standards for the Electrical Industry)
(1) The Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment shall establish, manage, and administer a systematic set of technical standards for the stable supply and convenient use of electricity. <Amended on October 1, 2025>
(2) The Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment may designate an institution or organization meeting the criteria prescribed by Presidential Decree and entrust it with duties concerning the establishment, management, and administration of technical standards under paragraph (1), and may support all or part of the costs necessary for carrying out the entrusted projects. <Amended on October 1, 2025>
(3) Matters necessary for designation, entrustment, and the payment, use, and management of support funds under paragraph (2), etc. shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.

CHAPTER IV SUPPLEMENTARY PROVISIONS

Article 16 (Establishment of an Inter-Institutional Consultative Body for the Electrical Industry)
(1) The Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment may establish a consultative body with relevant administrative agencies, local governments, corporations, and organizations for the sustainable development of the electrical industry. <Amended on October 1, 2025>
(2) The Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment may provide support necessary for the operation of the consultative body. <Amended on October 1, 2025>
(3) Matters necessary for the organization, operation, and duties of the consultative body under paragraph (1), the details of support under paragraph (2), etc. shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.

Article 17 (Establishment and Operation of the Korea Electrical Industry Federation)
(1) Business operators, institutions, organizations, etc. related to the electrical industry shall establish the Korea Electrical Industry Federation (hereinafter referred to as the "Federation"), with authorization from the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment, to promote the sound development of the electrical industry and efficiently perform their duties. <Amended on October 1, 2025; March 17, 2026>
(2) The Federation shall be a juristic person. <Amended on March 17, 2026>
(3) Except as provided in this Act, the provisions of the Civil Act concerning incorporated associations shall apply mutatis mutandis to the Federation. <Amended on March 17, 2026>
(4) Other matters necessary for the articles of association, authorization of establishment, operation, and supervision of the Federation shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree. <Amended on March 17, 2026>

Article 18 (Delegation and Entrustment of Authority, etc.)
(1) Part of the authority of the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment under this Act may be delegated to the Special Metropolitan City Mayor, Metropolitan City Mayors, the Special Self-Governing City Mayor, Do Governors, Special Self-Governing Province Governors, or the heads of affiliated agencies, or entrusted to the heads of other central administrative agencies, as prescribed by Presidential Decree. <Amended on October 1, 2025>
(2) Part of the duties of the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment under this Act may be entrusted to public institutions, the Federation, and other institutions or organizations related to the electrical industry, as prescribed by Presidential Decree. <Amended on October 1, 2025; March 17, 2026>

ADDENDA <Act No. 19956, January 9, 2024>

This Act shall enter into force one year after the date of its promulgation.

ADDENDA (Government Organization Act) <Act No. 21065, October 1, 2025>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Act shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation: Provided, That, among the Acts amended pursuant to Article 7 of these Addenda, the provisions amending Acts that were promulgated before this Act enters into force but have not yet entered into force shall enter into force on the respective enforcement dates of those Acts ... <Omitted.> ... .

1. and 2. Omitted.

Articles 2 through 6: Omitted.

Article 7 (Amendments to Other Acts)
(1) through (268): Omitted.

(269) The Framework Act on the Development of the Electrical Industry is partially amended as follows:

In Article 7 (1), the main clause of paragraph (3) of that Article, the former part of paragraph (4) of that Article, and the former and latter parts of paragraph (5) of that Article; Article 8 (1) and the former part of paragraph (2) of that Article; Article 9 (1) and (2); Article 10 (1), the part of paragraph (2) of that Article preceding its subparagraphs, and paragraph (3) of that Article; Article 11 (1) and (2); Article 12; Article 13 (1) through (3); Article 15 (1) and (2); Article 16 (1) and (2); Article 17 (1); and Article 18 (1) and (2), "Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy" shall each be replaced by "Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment".

(270) through (626): Omitted.

Article 8: Omitted.

ADDENDA <Act No. 21469, March 17, 2026>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Act shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

Article 2 (Transitional Measures concerning Korea Electric Association)
(1) Korea Electric Association, an incorporated association established under Article 32 of the Civil Act and existing at the time this Act enters into force (hereinafter referred to as "Korea Electric Association, an incorporated association"), may, following a resolution of its general meeting, apply to the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment for authorization to establish the Federation under the amended provisions of Article 17.
(2) Where authorization from the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment is obtained upon an application under paragraph (1), Korea Electric Association, an incorporated association, shall be deemed the Federation established under the amended provisions of Article 17.
(3) Upon obtaining authorization under paragraph (1), Korea Electric Association, an incorporated association, shall register the incorporation of the Federation without delay.
(4) Upon completing the registration of incorporation under paragraph (3), Korea Electric Association, an incorporated association, shall be deemed dissolved, notwithstanding the provisions of the Civil Act concerning the dissolution and liquidation of corporations.
(5) The Federation established under the amended provisions of Article 17 shall, on the date of registration of incorporation, succeed in their entirety to all property, rights, and obligations of Korea Electric Association, an incorporated association. In such cases, the value of the property to which the Federation succeeds shall be its book value at the time of succession.
(6) The name of Korea Electric Association, an incorporated association, appearing in registers and other official records relating to the property, rights, and obligations to which the Federation has succeeded in their entirety under paragraph (5) shall be deemed the name of the Federation established under the amended provisions of Article 17.
(7) Any act performed by Korea Electric Association, an incorporated association, or with respect to Korea Electric Association, an incorporated association, before this Act enters into force shall be deemed an act performed by the Federation established under the amended provisions of Article 17 or with respect to the Federation established under the amended provisions of Article 17, respectively.
(8) The officers and employees of Korea Electric Association, an incorporated association, holding office or employed at the time this Act enters into force shall be deemed the officers and employees of the Federation under the amended provisions of Article 17, and the terms of office of the officers shall run from their previous dates of appointment.

Article 3 (Relationship with Other Statutes and Regulations)
Where other statutes or regulations cite Korea Electric Association, an incorporated association, at the time this Act enters into force, they shall be deemed to cite the Federation under the amended provisions of Article 17 in its place.
